exposure: Group 2b (pre-labor single cephalic nulliparous women at term)
Group 2a (induced single cephalic nulliparous women at term)
Group 1 (single cephalic nulliparous women presenting in spontaneous labor at term)
Group 5 (single cephalic multiparous women at term with a previous CD)
cohort: 88,044 mothers delivering 89,649 babies ≥500 g at the National Maternity Hospital between 2005-2014
finding: The increase in cesarean delivery rate at the National Maternity Hospital was primarily driven by induction of labor and pre-labor cesarean delivery in nulliparous women with a single cephalic pregnancy at term.
